label.title: Label
label.description: Label is a short description of the period.

start.title: Start
start.description: Start indicates when this period starts, required if there is no end date.

end.title: End
end.description:
End indicates when the period ends, required if there is no start date,
and must be on or after the start date.

cal.Period.description: Period represents a span of time bounded by a start and/or an end date.
